Job Title: Environmental Construction Manager II Location: Remote with travel to project sites Description/Job Summary POSITION DESCRIPTION Are you ready to take on a new job that provides a perfect platform to grow yourself and your career?

HGL currently has a position open for an experienced Construction Manager II to support various environmental remediation projects throughout the United States.

As a Construction Manager II, you will be responsible for planning, initiating, and executing various construction and environmental remediation projects for clients including the USEPA, USACE, NASA, and other organizations across our projects.

Projects may include landfill remediation and cap construction, demolition, mine-waste cleanup, in-situ thermal treatment, soil mixing, groundwater remediation, contaminated soil/sediment excavations, utility installation, PFAS mitigation and other technologies/techniques. This position requires approximately 25% travel to active project sites.

Responsibilities/Duties WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING The successful candidate will: Coordinate with the Construction Director, Construction TSG management team and Project Managers to develop staffing plans and schedules. Travel to project sites (25-50%) during various work phases to kick-off work activities, train project personnel, and perform audits.

Lead internal and external project meetings. Regularly interface with field personnel, project managers, technical staff, and clients to support all components of project work. Generate and review planning documents and subcontractor scopes of work. Generate and review project specifications and construction drawings.

Procure materials, equipment, and subcontractor personnel. Identify and mitigate project risks relating to quality control and health and safety. Manage HGL Construction Team members as a Supervisor.

Minimum Requirements WHAT YOU NEED TO BE SUCCESSFUL The ideal candidate will need the following as a foundation for success in this role: Minimum of 10 years’ experience serving in a construction management role (office or field) for environmental remediation projects. Strong working knowledge of CERCLA, RCRA, and OSHA regulations.

Strong understanding of EM385-1-1. Excellent communication, organization, and team-building skills. Strong technical writing and project documentation experience. Ability to work in a fast-paced environment in a team-oriented setting to manage multiple activities with excellent attention to detail.

Experience working on large project sites with contaminated soil, sediment, and groundwater subject to HAZWOPER regulations. Experience forecasting, scheduling, and staffing multiple concurrent projects. Proficiency in the Microsoft Office suite of software, specifically Excel, Word, and Project.

Desired Qualifications WHAT YOU NEED TO STAND OUT – Preferred, not required Strong demonstrated leadership qualities. Experience implementing the USACE 3-Phase Quality Control System. Experience managing USACE and EPA remediation construction projects. Experience with the USACE Resident Management System (RMS).

Current certifications including: 40-hour HAZWOPER and 8-hour refresher; OSHA 30-hour Construction Training; USACE CQM-C; and first aid/CPR. Physical & Environmental Requirements PHYSICAL & COGNITIVE REQUIRMENTS Ability to lift/move/relocate items up to 50 lbs.

Prolonged sitting up to 70% of the time; Prolonged standing up to 70% of the time Walking long distances; Walking over uneven or mountainous terrain Repetitive hand motions (typing/tool use/etc.) Ability to see details at close range; Ability to see details at a distance; Ability to interpret and analyze visual data (maps/graphs/warning indicators/etc.) Driving a company or personal vehicle Analyzing and synthesizing data Complex problem solving and decision making Reading and interpreting technical documents or regulations Writing reports, proposals, or technical documentation Leading a team or coordinating multiple priorities Communicating effectively with clients/team members/and stakeholders Managing competing deadlines and shifting priorities WORK ENVIRONMENT REQUIREMENTS Must be able to work outdoors in adverse weather conditions (heat/cold/rain/snow/etc.) Must be able to travel up to 25% yearly May work in environments with loud noises/dust/or hazardous materials Must wear appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE) Remote work environment Potential for longer days up to 12 hours in duration This description is not a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that may be required of the employee.

Other duties, responsibilities and activities may be assigned or may be changed at any time with or without notice. Details Work Schedule: HGL office work is dictated by a 5-day work week; however, fieldwork schedules will deviate based on job requirements and may require longer hours and weekends. Office Type: Project site, field work.

Office work is minimal. Travel: 25-50%, mostly in the 25% range. A favorable pre-hire drug test and physical are required. All positions are subject to a pre-hire education and driving record verification.

MORE ABOUT HGL AND THE OPPORTUNITY At HGL, we share a drive and vision to restore natural resources and provide ongoing stewardship of our environment to benefit present and future generations. We believe that we can make a difference in improving the world we live in through collaboration, teamwork, and a positive work environment.

This unites and empowers us to strive for excellence in all our endeavors. HGL - WHO WE ARE The exceptional quality of our people is key to our strength. We value our employees as individuals and as important members of our team. We offer a work environment that is flexible, inclusive, and dedicated to creating a sustainable future.

By cultivating a culture of innovation, we’re able to adapt and augment our services to solve complex environmental and natural resources challenges.

Projects at HGL primarily span the United States and its territories, tackling problems associated with emerging contaminants (like PFAS), radiological contamination, and military munitions, along with chemical contamination in groundwater, surface water, sediments, and soil.

With over 550 employees, HGL is large enough to execute high-profile projects, but small enough to develop personal working environments with our talented team members. By joining HGL, you will be working toward restoring the environment and protecting our future. HGL - WE INVEST IN YOU It’s not just a job, it’s your career.

HGL provides career growth opportunities via mentoring, training, education, and support for your certifications and licenses. Achieve your career goals and help HGL achieve its mission of restoring the environment to beneficial use for our clients and communities. We are an Equal Opportunity employer.

All applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or other protected category. Some positions may require U.S. citizenship.

Applicants who wish to request a reasonable accommodation during the recruitment process should contact Human Resources directly at 703-478-5186. EEO notices: US Equal Opportunity Employment Poster , US Equal Opportunity Supplemental Poster , Know Your Rights , and Pay Transparency Notice .

A full list of benefits is available at www.hgl.com/careers/ . The annual salary for this position ranges from $107,830 - $167,137. This position's final salary can be impacted by various factors including, but not limited to, contractual requirements, geographic location, job-related education, training, experience, and skills.

If your desired salary falls outside of this range, we hope you'll still apply as there may be other positions that better align. Originally posted on Himalayas

Der einzige dreisprachige Kanton der Schweiz ist wirtschaftlich, kulturell und politisch vielfältig. Graubünden ist mit 7106 km² der grösste Kanton der Schweiz und bietet mit 150 Tälern, 615 Seen, 140 Ferienorten und unzähligen Sonnentagen pro Jahr eine hohe Lebensqualität. Die Kantonale Verwaltung Graubünden ist genauso vielseitig wie unsere Landschaft. Bringen Sie Ihre einzigartigen Fähigkeiten ein und gestalten Sie gemeinsam mit uns die Zukunft der Kantonalen Verwaltung Graubünden.
Das Tiefbauamt ist für die Projektierung, den Bau, die Erhaltung und den Betrieb der Kantonsstrassen sowie den Wasserbau und den Langsamverkehr in Graubünden zuständig. Ausserdem kümmern wir uns um den betrieblichen Unterhalt der Nationalstrassen auf dem Kantonsgebiet.

Die Strasseninfrastruktur des Kantons umfasst über 1'450 Kunstbauten, darunter Brücken in luftigen Höhen bis 90 Meter und Tunnels mit bis zu 3 Kilometern Länge. Die Herausforderungen, die die Natur unseres Gebirgskantons im und mit sich bringt, macht unsere Arbeit anspruchsvoll und vielseitig.

Als Friendly Work Space zertifiziertes Amt liegen uns die Gesundheit und Zufriedenheit unserer rund 480 Mitarbeitenden besonders am Herzen. Aus diesem Grund engagieren wir uns für ein systematisches Betriebliches Gesundheitsmanagement (BGM).
Wir suchen für die Abteilung Strassenbau per 1\. November 2026 oder nach Vereinbarung eine/\-n Bauleiter/\-in Bau Hauptstrassen.
Ihr Aufgabenbereich
Leitung und Kontrolle der zugeteilten Baustellen als Bauherrenvertreter/\-in

Sicherstellen von Qualität, Ausmass und Ausführung der gesamten Vertragsarbeit
Erstellen von Kostenvoranschlägen, Ausschreibungsunterlagen und Abrechnungen
Überwachung des Budgets
Das wünschen wir uns von Ihnen

Praxiserfahrung in der Devisierung
Persönlichkeit mit Durchsetzungsvermögen, Organisations\- und Verhandlungsgeschick sowie Teamfähigkeit
Allgemeine Arbeitssprache ist Deutsch, gute Kenntnisse in mehreren Kantonssprachen von Vorteil
Unsere Vorteile

Bauleitung für Hochbau \& Innenarchitektur
------------------------------------------
Dein Partner für aussergewöhnliche Bauvorhaben Wir stehen für innovative Architektur, kreative Innenraumgestaltung und exklusives Design. Spezialisiert auf Neu- und Umbauten in den Bereichen Gastronomie, Hotellerie, Gesundheit (Kliniken, Praxen, Wellness) und privaten Wohnbau realisieren wir individuelle Projekte mit höchster Raumqualität.
Verstärke unser Team Du bist ein guter Organisator, ergebnisorientiert, zuverlässig und besitzt ein gesundes Durchsetzungsvermögen? Du arbeitest professionell und kundenorientiert, bist flexibel und fühlst dich in einem dynamischen Umfeld wohl?

Dann werde Teil unseres Teams und nutze dein Können, deine Teamfähigkeit und dein Engagement in einer vielseitigen und selbstständigen Rolle. Von Projektbeginn bis zur mängelfreien Übergabe übernimmst du Verantwortung für spannende Bauvorhaben mit Schwerpunkt im Hochbau und in der Innenarchitektur.
Deine Perspektiven
* Abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit mit hoher Eigenverantwortung
* Moderner Arbeitsplatz, flache Hierarchien und kollegiales Team
* Individuelle Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten und langfristige Perspektive
* Leitung innovativer und anspruchsvoller Bauprojekte
Deine Aufgabe
* Eigenverantwortliche Bauleitung und Ausführung von Neubau-, Umbau- und Sanierungsprojekten in allen Phasen
* Bauadministration: Einholen und Prüfen von Angeboten, Ausarbeiten von Ausschreibungsunterlagen sowie Verantwortung für die Einhaltung von Termin-, Qualitäts-, Sicherheits- und Kostenanforderungen inklusive Kostenplanung, Baukostenoptimierung, laufendem Controlling und Bauabrechnung
* Enge Zusammenarbeit und Koordination mit Bauherrschaft, Behörden, Architekten, Fachplanern und Subunternehmern zur Sicherstellung einer reibungslosen Abwicklung
* Risikomanagement und Problemlösung während des gesamten Projektverlaufs
Dein Profil
* Mehrjährige Erfahrung als Bauleiter in der Schweiz, idealerweise mit einer Ausbildung zum Dipl. Bauleiter oder einer gleichwertigen Ausbildung im Bauwesen
* Hohe Koordinationsfähigkeit sowie eine lösungsorientierte, exakte Arbeitsweise mit strukturierter Vorgehensweise
* Du denkst unternehmerisch, kannst Referenzen im Um- und Neubau vorweisen und hast mehrjährige Erfahrung im Hoch- und Innenausbau

# Group Statutory Reporting Supervisor #
**Location:** Vevey, Switzerland
**Work model:** Office-based with hybrid flexibility / Full time
**Contract type / duration:** Permanent contract
**Target start date:** As soon as possible
**Deadline for applications:** 6 September 2026
** **
**Be a force for good and** **grow through experiences** **that** **push you further.**
As Group Statutory Reporting Supervisor, you will be responsible for a defined portfolio of entities, overseeing Period End Closing, statutory reporting, and remaining accounting-related processes in the market.

You will act as guardian of market accounting policies and procedures, safeguarding balance sheet integrity, and serve as a key point of contact for Shared Services Centers on Accounting Operations questions and improvement initiatives.

In this role, you will also partner with the wider Finance community to strengthen controls, service quality, and end-to-end improvements.
**How you-ll make an impact as ****Group Statutory Reporting Supervisor**
* Coordinating Period End Closing in a network organization, including Shared Services, ensuring accurate and timely financial reporting.
* Acting as a trusted partner and key link with the Finance community, including the CFOs, Business Controllers, Group Consolidation, external auditors, and other stakeholders.
* Ensuring compliance with Nestlé guidelines, instructions, and best practices across market-related scopes.
* Collaborating actively with Shared Services Centers and Functions to drive end-to-end improvement initiatives.
* Producing market statutory reporting in compliance with Swiss accounting regulations.
* Coordinating the completion of remaining in-market Group reporting responsibilities and publication, including equity reconciliation.
* Acting as a subject matter expert on specific IFRS and local GAAP requirements, including the Code of Obligations and Swiss GAAP FER.
**What will make you successful**
* Strong background in the Finance, Accounting, or a related field, complemented by a professional qualification such as Chartered Accountant or equivalent; a Swiss GAAP-specific certification, such as Swiss CPA or similar, is a strong asset.
* Bringing established experience in accounting and audit, ideally including tax accounting, gained within a Big 4 firm or a corporate international environment.
* Demonstrating significant in-house statutory accounting experience, with a proven track record of delivering finance and accounting projects.
* Demonstrated ability to effectively engage and communicate with management, Finance & Control leadership, and external parties, including external auditors.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex financial data.
* Significant and demonstrated experience in in-house statutory accounting.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel; experience with SAP and CFiN is an advantage.

As Construction Project Manager, you will lead and manage all construction aspects of small to medium-sized building projects. You will ensure the delivery of safe, compliant, sustainable, and innovative property solutions that meet the needs of the business and the many people.

· Take responsibility for the successful delivery of construction projects - from planning through to completion.
· Ensure that safety, compliance, sustainability, and quality requirements are met.

· Coordinate internal stakeholders across Real Estate and core business areas, as well as external partners.
· Work closely with authorities, consultants, suppliers, and contractors.

You are a structured, communicative, and solution-oriented professional with experience in construction project management. You know how to bring different interests together, prepare clear decisions and move projects forward reliably.

Way of working: Confident in managing budgets, timelines, permits, stakeholders, and external project partners.
Languages: Fluent in German and English; French would be an advantage.
You will create an environment where values, collaboration and diversity are a living reality - for co-workers, contractors, and customers.

As the EPCM contractor for Lithium Americas, Bechtel is responsible for managing and integrating the efforts of a team contractors engineering and building the facility. We are also managing procurement of about $1 Billion in goods and services.
Earth work began in 2023 and design and procurement of long-lead equipment is underway.

Once the second phase of the project is complete, Thacker Pass will produce more than 16 times the current U.S. output of lithium.

Basic Requirements: This position has a positive Education Requirement in addition to at least one year of Specialized Experience or substitution of education for experience or combination (if applicable) in order to be found minimally qualified. Transcripts must be submitted with your application package.

You MUST meet the following requirements: EDUCATION: Basic Requirements: A. Degree: Engineering.

To be acceptable, the program must: (1) lead to a bachelor's degree in a school of engineering with at least one program accredited by ABET; or (2) include differential and integral calculus and courses (more advanced than first-year physics and chemistry) in five of the following seven areas of engineering science or physics: (a) statics, dynamics; (b) strength of materials (stress-strain relationships); (c) fluid mechanics, hydraulics; (d) thermodynamics; (e) electrical fields and circuits; (f) nature and properties of materials (relating particle and aggregate structure to properties); and (g) any other comparable area of fundamental engineering science or physics, such as optics, heat transfer, soil mechanics, or electronics.

OR B.

Combination of education and experience -- college-level education, training, and/or technical experience that furnished (1) a thorough knowledge of the physical and mathematical sciences underlying engineering, and (2) a good understanding, both theoretical and practical, of the engineering sciences and techniques and their applications to one of the branches of engineering.

The adequacy of such background must be demonstrated by one of the following: 1. Professional registration or licensure -- Current registration as an Engineer Intern (EI), Engineer in Training (EIT)1, or licensure as a Professional Engineer (PE) by any State, the District of Columbia, Guam, or Puerto Rico.

Absent other means of qualifying under this standard, those applicants who achieved such registration by means other than written test (e.g., State grandfather or eminence provisions) are eligible only for positions that are within or closely related to the specialty field of their registration.

For example, an applicant who attains registration through a State Board's eminence provision as a manufacturing engineer typically would be rated eligible only for manufacturing engineering positions. 2.

Written Test -- Evidence of having successfully passed the Fundamentals of Engineering (FE)2 examination or any other written test required for professional registration by an engineering licensure board in the various States, the District of Columbia, Guam, and Puerto Rico. 3.

Specified academic courses -- Successful completion of at least 60 semester hours of courses in the physical, mathematical, and engineering sciences and that included the courses specified in the basic requirements under paragraph A.

The courses must be fully acceptable toward meeting the requirements of an engineering program as described in paragraph A. 4.

Related curriculum -- Successful completion of a curriculum leading to a bachelor's degree in an appropriate scientific field, e.g., engineering technology, physics, chemistry, architecture, computer science, mathematics, hydrology, or geology, may be accepted in lieu of a bachelor's degree in engineering, provided the applicant has had at least 1 year of professional engineering experience acquired under professional engineering supervision and guidance.

Ordinarily there should be either an established plan of intensive training to develop professional engineering competence, or several years of prior professional engineering-type experience, e.g., in interdisciplinary positions.

(The above examples of related curricula are not all-inclusive.) AND To qualify at the GS-12 grade level, your resume must demonstrate at least one (1) full year of specialized experience equivalent to at least the GS-11 grade level in the federal or private sector.

Specialized experience is experience that has equipped you with the ability, skill, and knowledge to successfully perform the duties of this position and is typically in or related to this line of work. Examples of specialized experience include performing the following types of tasks on a regular basis.

NOTE: All experience statements (i.e., duties, specialized experience, or occupational assessment questionnaire) copied from this announcement and pasted into your resume will not be considered as a demonstration of your qualifications for this position.

Specialized experience may include the following: Planning specific objectives, milestones, and phases for complex engineering projects; Performing facility asset management; developing project priorities and programming strategies; Providing technical guidance to contractor counterparts; conducting site visits; Planning and executing logistics responsibilities; or planning and conducting interdisciplinary studies and investigations.

NOTE: Education cannot be substituted for experience at this grade level.

National Service Experience (i.e., volunteer experience): Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional, philanthropic, religious, spiritual, community, student, social).

Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience.

====================
**Directeur / Directrice de travaux**
**Taux d'activité : 80% \- 100 %

DT Concept SA, bureau d'architecture et direction de travaux basé à Fenil\-sur\-Corsier, recherche un·e directeur·trice de travaux à 80% \- 100% pour assurer le suivi de ses chantiers dans les cantons de Vaud, Fribourg et Valais, de la coordination avec les entreprises jusqu'à la réception des ouvrages.
**L'essentiel en un coup d'œil**
---------------------------------
* Domicile situé à moins de 30 km de nos bureaux à Fenil\-sur\-Corsier
* Minimum 3 ans d'expérience dans une fonction similaire
* CFC de dessinateur/trice en architecture requis
* Diplôme ES : un atout majeur
* Français langue maternelle
* Permis de conduire catégorie B obligatoire
**Votre mission**
-----------------
Rattaché(e) à notre bureau, vous prenez en charge le suivi de nos chantiers situés dans les cantons de Vaud, Fribourg et Valais. À ce titre, vous assurez :
* La coordination avec les entreprises intervenant sur les chantiers
* L'établissement des soumissions et leur vérification
* La participation aux séances d'adjudication
* Le contrôle des coûts et le suivi budgétaire des chantiers
* Des travaux de dessin technique
* Le suivi de l'avancement des travaux et le respect des délais et de la qualité d'exécution
**Votre profil**
----------------
* CFC de dessinateur/trice en architecture (requis)
* Diplôme ES (atout majeur)
* Au moins 3 ans d'expérience dans une fonction similaire
* Français langue maternelle
* Domicilié(e) à 30 km au maximum de Fenil\-sur\-Corsier
* Bonne maîtrise des outils informatiques usuels ; la maîtrise d'ArchiCad est un atout
* Connaissance des normes SIA et de la réglementation de la construction en Suisse romande
* Permis de conduire catégorie B obligatoire
* Rigueur, sens de l'organisation et capacité à gérer plusieurs chantiers en parallèle
* Aisance relationnelle et bon esprit de négociation avec les différents intervenants
* Autonomie et esprit d'initiative
**Ce que nous offrons**
-----------------------
Vous évoluerez dans une ambiance de travail à la fois professionnelle et dynamique, au sein d'une équipe engagée et attentive à la qualité des projets réalisés. Nous vous offrons un cadre favorisant l'autonomie, la collaboration et le développement de vos compétences, tout en participant activement au suivi de chantiers variés dans plusieurs cantons.
* Contrat à durée indéterminée
* Véhicule de service
* Une rémunération intéressante et de nombreux avantages
**À propos de DT Concept SA**
------------------------------
Fondé en avril 2011, DT Concept SA est un bureau d'architecture et de direction de travaux moderne, dynamique et exigeant.
Nous développons notre activité avec dynamisme, en donnant la priorité aux solutions sur mesure et au respect de nos engagements, au sein d'une structure à taille humaine, réactive et performante.
En tant qu'interlocuteur unique, nous assurons la mise à l’enquête, la planification, la direction et la conduite des travaux, la gestion financière, jusqu'à la réception de l'ouvrage. Plus qu'un prestataire, nous nous considérons comme un véritable partenaire dans la réalisation de votre projet.
**Intéressé(e) ?**
--------------------
Envoyez\-nous votre dossier de candidature complet (CV, lettre de motivation et copies de diplômes/certificats de travail) directement via la plateforme à l'attention de Madame Maria Preite.
Nous vous remercions pour votre candidature et vous informons que nous ne répondrons qu'aux dossiers correspondant au profil recherché. Merci de votre compréhension.

To strengthen our growing Data Center team, we are looking for an experienced **Construction Manager CSA (m/f/d)**. Your contractual workplace will be our "Connect" office in Opfikon, while your **main place of work will be one of our Data Center construction projects in the Zurich region**.

*What tasks can you expect as a Construction Manager CSA (m/f/d) - Data Center*
* Lead and coordinate the execution of all Civil, Structural and Architectural (CSA) works on a large-scale Data Center project, ensuring delivery in line with safety, quality, budget and schedule requirements
* Manage subcontractors, supervisors and site teams while driving short-term planning through 2-, 4- and 8-week look-ahead schedules and daily coordination activities
* Oversee critical interfaces between CSA and MEP disciplines, ensuring work areas, rooms and systems are handed over to commissioning and installation teams on time
* Monitor construction progress, productivity and resources, proactively identifying risks, constraints and recovery actions to maintain project milestones
* Ensure full compliance with project specifications, Swiss regulations, SIA standards, fire protection requirements, HSE regulations and quality management processes

*What qualifications do you bring as a Construction Manager CSA (m/f/d) - Data Center?*
* 8-10+ years of construction experience with significant site management responsibility, including the successful delivery of major CSA packages from construction through commissioning and handover
* Proven experience on hyperscale Data Center, mission-critical, industrial or other highly complex construction projects, with a strong understanding of CSA and MEP interfaces
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple subcontractors simultaneously, driving short-term planning, look-ahead schedules, sequencing, productivity and constraint management
* Strong technical understanding of construction drawings, BIM models, specifications and project schedules, combined with hands-on experience in quality inspections, snagging and structured handovers
* Degree or equivalent qualification in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, Architecture or a related discipline; experience with Swiss construction standards (SIA/VKF), Tier-1 contractors and Primavera P6 is an advantage

To strengthen our rapidly growing Data Center team, we are looking for a **Health & Safety Supervisor (m/f/d)**who is passionate about creating and maintaining a world-class safety culture on complex, high-profile mission-critical projects.
In this challenging role, you will be responsible for supporting and monitoring all health, safety and environmental activities on site, ensuring compliance with Swiss regulations, client requirements and Implenia's high HSE standards.

You will work closely with project management, subcontractors and client representatives to ensure that safety remains our highest priority throughout every phase of construction.

The role reflects key responsibilities commonly found in leading international data center projects, including site inspections, contractor management, risk assessments, training, incident investigations and emergency preparedness.
Your contractual workplace will be our**"Connect" office in Opfikon**, while your **main place of work** will be one of our **Data Center construction projects in the Zurich region**.

*What tasks can you expect as a Health & Safety Supervisor (m/f/d)?*
* Promote and actively drive a strong health, safety and environmental culture across the Data Center project, ensuring compliance with all site, client and regulatory requirements.
* Conduct site inspections, audits and risk assessments, proactively identifying hazards and implementing corrective and preventive actions.
* Monitor and support subcontractors in meeting HSE standards, including inductions, permits to work, toolbox talks, RAMS/WMS reviews and documentation management.
* Investigate incidents, near misses and unsafe conditions, perform root cause analyses and contribute to the implementation of effective improvement measures.Deliver HSE training and daily safety briefings, provide expert guidance to project stakeholders and support the continuous improvement of HSE processes and site documentation.

*What qualifications do you bring as a Health & Safety Supervisor (m/f/d)?*
* Must hold at least diploma level recognised qualification in Occupational Safety, Health and Welfare at Work, Construction safety management or recognised equivalent diploma
* Several years of EHS experience on large-scale construction projects in pharmaceutical, industrial, infrastructure, or Data Center projects.
* Strong knowledge of construction safety management, risk assessment methodologies, contractor management, and permit-to-work systems working at least at General Contractor level
* Confident communicator with the ability to engage professionally with workforce teams, subcontractors, and management while fostering a strong safety culture
* The ability to work independently and as part of a team
* **Fluent in English; German is a strong advantage**
* Relevant EHS certifications (e.g., NEBOSH, SUVA, ISO 45001, or equivalent) are highly desirable
